title: Create: Recipe Extensions
description: This mod adds new recipes to create. The recipes are easy to enable/disable via config.
body:
# Create: Recipe Extensions

**New configurable recipes for the Create mod - toggle each one individually to fit your playstyle or modpack.**

Create: Recipe Extensions adds a set of new machine recipes to [Create](https://modrinth.com/mod/create), filling in gaps for materials that have no automation path by default. Each recipe can be individually enabled or disabled in the config, giving you full control over what gets added to your game.

---

## Recipes

### Cinder Flour (Filling)
Automate Cinder Flour production by filling a container with Redstone and a Strength Potion.

### Netherrack (Compacting)
Compact Flint, Cobblestone, Nether Wart, and Lava together to produce Netherrack. Gives Create an automation path for a material that otherwise has no renewable source in the overworld.

### Tuff (Mixing)
Mix Andesite, Cobblestone, and Lava in a heated Mixing basin to produce Tuff.

### Dripstone Block (Crushing)
Crush Dripstone Blocks into Limestone and Calcite.

### Limestone (Mixing)
Mix Limestone and Water in a heated Mixing basin to produce Dripstone Blocks.

### Veridium (Mixing)
Mix Clay Balls, Flint, and Lava in a Mixing basin to produce Veridium.

### Asurine (Mixing)
Mix Clay Balls, Flint, and Water in a Mixing basin to produce Asurine.

---

## Integrations

### Create: Vibrant Vaults *(optional)*
When [Create: Vibrant Vaults](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-vibrant-vaults) is installed, a Deployer holding a Wrench can convert any Item Vault into its vertical variant - all 16 dye colors plus the base vault are supported. This allows bulk automated production of vertical vaults without clicking each one by hand.

---

## Config

All recipes are individually toggleable in the config file.

- **Fabric** - uses [Cloth Config](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config)
- **Forge / NeoForge** - uses the built-in config system

---

## Supported Versions

| Minecraft | Platform  | Status    |
|-----------|-----------|-----------|
| 1.20.1    | Fabric    | ✅ Active  |
| 1.20.1    | Forge     | ✅ Active  |
| 1.20.1    | NeoForge  | ✅ Active  |

---

## Dependencies

- [Create](https://modrinth.com/mod/create)
- [Cloth Config](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config) *(Fabric only)*
